skill.summary: AI outfit generator — redesign a complete outfit on a person photo based on style prompt

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the outfit-generator skill.
- Generates a complete new outfit on a person photo based on a style prompt.
- Uses secure API key authentication; API key is required and must only be sent to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Supports uploading and processing a single image at a time.
- Customizable style prompts and output batch size (1–16).
- Includes clear security and usage instructions.
